wordmark.purpose: Cream Digi World identity beneath the globe.

slogan.purpose: Exact safety slogan below the wordmark.

tip.purpose: Rotating message in the lower-left popup.

shadows.name: identity-shadow
shadows.purpose: Separates outlined cream identity from the moving neighborhood.

shadows.name: play-shadow
shadows.purpose: Lifts the rectangular Play action above the street.

shadows.name: tip-shadow
shadows.purpose: Lifts the white tip card from the street.

motion.name: welcome-reveal
motion.value: 5.5s welcoming sequence: globe and blur enter in 0.7s; greeting at 0.9–2.9s; two globe and horizontal ring turns; settle at 2.4–3.7s; title at 3.15s, slogan at 3.7s, Play at 4.4s, tips at 4.7s
motion.purpose: Welcomes the player personally, then reveals Digi World and the action in a deliberate sequence.

motion.name: identity-bob
motion.value: 8s sine cycle; y 0 to -4 scaled px
motion.purpose: Keeps the globe and wordmark gently moving.

motion.name: street-preview
motion.purpose: Gives the opening neighborhood more time to breathe.

motion.name: tip-rotation
motion.value: 5s interval; 0.2s fade out and 0.25s fade in

motion.name: identity-flight
motion.value: 0.55s cubic ease-out fade and background blur release; identity y -28 scaled px; corner mark follows after 0.18s
motion.purpose: Clears the welcome identity and sharpens the neighborhood as the flight starts.

components.name: Play Button
components.description: Solid coral rectangle with white Play label, soft shadow, and clear keyboard focus; portable preview of the native Godot control.
components.css: .ds-play { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:220px; height:62px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:#FF7F42; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; font-size:32px; font-weight:700; box-shadow:0 7px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25); cursor:pointer; } .ds-play:hover { background:#FF965E; box-shadow:0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.29); } .ds-play:active { background:#DB522E; box-shadow:none; } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #F9F1DA; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Welcome Identity
components.description: Globe-and-orbit logo with cream Digi World wordmark and the exact cyber-safety slogan over the live street.
components.html:
DIGI WORLD
Become a Cyber Hero. Keep your world safe!
components.css: .ds-identity { text-align:center; color:#FAEFDC; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; } .ds-globe { display:block; width:340px; max-width:100%; height:183px; margin:auto; } .ds-wordmark { margin-top:-8px; font-size:68px; font-weight:700; line-height:1; -webkit-text-stroke:15px #0D2B38; paint-order:stroke fill; text-shadow:0 10px rgba(13,43,56,.35); } .ds-slogan { margin-top:10px; font-size:23px; font-weight:600; -webkit-text-stroke:8px #0D2B38; paint-order:stroke fill; }

components.name: Safety Tip Popup
components.description: Lower-left white card; Godot cycles five safety tips every five seconds.
components.html: Tip: Long passwords are stronger than short ones!
components.css: .ds-tip { width:270px; min-height:98px; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:18px 18px 18px 4px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#12394A; font-family:Fredoka,'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif; font-size:21px; font-weight:600; box-shadow:0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25); } .ds-tip strong { color:#E4622A; }

narrative.overview: The imported globe-and-orbit mark and native Fredoka wordmark greet players over the moving neighborhood. The exact cyber-safety slogan sits beneath. A screen-space blur softens the neighborhood behind the sharp welcome UI, arriving with the words and clearing when Play starts the established camera flight. A small white popup rotates online-safety tips. The neighborhood environment system remains the authority for 3D geometry and materials.

rules.name: The Live Street Rule
rules.body: Keep the neighborhood visible behind the opening interface; its changing scenery is part of the composition.

dos: Do keep the compact logo, exact slogan, rectangular Play action, and tip popup readable over the moving neighborhood.
Do retain the centered Play action, lower-left tip card, and transition to the small corner mark during flight.
donts: Don't cover the live neighborhood with a full-screen card on this welcome surface.
Don't apply this interface palette or typography as a replacement for the separate 3D environment system.
